headlines.text: It was 2023 when Kenny Omega vs. Jeff Cobb went to battle over the IWGP United States Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.73 ? a good, competitive contest. It was the first title opportunity of Jeff Cobb's career. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
That Friday in 2024, Nikita touched down in AEW for the first time against Mariah May, appearing on Rampage, rated 4.31.
On this day in 2024, Roderick Strong vs. Matt Menard met in an Eliminator Match, in the night's main event on Rampage, rated 5.42.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2023, Orange Cassidy vs. The Butcher clashed for the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.57. For The Butcher, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
Turning the clock back to 2023: Adam Cole vs. Daniel Garcia crossed paths for the first time ever, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 6.57.
Back on this day in 2023, it was the first-ever encounter between Ruby Soho and Willow Nightingale on Dynamite, rated 6.03.
